reset.title: Reset which envelope?
reset.body_one: Its QR and link stop working at once and you get new ones. The other envelope keeps working, and the person already in stays.
reset.body_other: Its QR and link stop working at once and you get new ones. The other envelope keeps working, and the {{count}} people already in stay.

closed.body: The roll closed on <value>{{date}}</value> and its photos were removed, so no one new can join.

onHold.body: Everglow is reviewing this roll after reports. Until then the envelope doesn’t admit anyone new. People already in can still look.

suspended.body: This roll was suspended for breaking our terms, so no one new can join.
